The selected mocked browser cases cover the transcript and parent approval path on desktop and mobile. Saved thinking is checked after reload across the 320, 390, and 430 px Chromium and WebKit profiles. Two real-Core cases cover durable child selection after refresh and restart recovery.

The mobile profiles are emulated; a physical device and a live external provider are unavailable for this branch test.
